description: This file contains migration logic for advanced permissions in Mattermost, including data structures, JSON serialization/deserialization, validation, and migration execution functions.

classes.name: AdvancedPermissionsPhase2Progress
classes.description: Data structure representing the progress of the advanced permissions phase 2 migration, including current table and last processed IDs.

methods.name: ToJSON
methods.description: Serializes the progress object to a JSON string.

methods.name: AdvancedPermissionsPhase2ProgressFromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data from an io.Reader into an AdvancedPermissionsPhase2Progress object.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the progress object IDs and current table value.

methods.name: runAdvancedPermissionsPhase2Migration
methods.description: Executes a batch of the advanced permissions phase 2 migration, updating progress and transitioning between stages.
